description: For roofing repair, this estimate request form records leak history, wet-area boundary, repair method, temporary protection, materials, weather window, and occupant coordination. Its supporting evidence includes moisture readings, test cuts, infrared or visual findings, photos, water test, and repair detail.

use_case: Use the estimate request form during roof leak diagnosis and repair execution when the roofing repair record must identify roof area, membrane or shingle system, penetrations, drainage, interior symptom, access, and warranty status. Complete the applicable handoff for watertightness verification, repair photos, warranty disposition, maintenance note, and customer signoff.
